Bangkok
Portraits

I’m Tong, a Thai documentary photographer based in Bangkok. These photos are from my documentary, fashion, lifestyle, and portrait work. I bring the same eye for people, light, and place to these sessions.

I’m building a portfolio of relaxed, candid portraits of Bangkok visitors in natural light. I’m offering a few free sessions for solo travelers, couples, and small groups in exchange for permission to use a few images we choose together.
